envelope.description: Support the independent controller reviewer with identical semantics

body.title: Support the independent controller reviewer with identical semantics
body.summary: Add controller plan/activity/result exchange to the design-review owner, binding authority to the actual trusted session and issued execution generation/sequence. Use the same assignments, schemas, coverage and result assessment as native review, without extracting task-review internals.
acceptanceChecks: Opposite party derives from artifact author; unknown author and caller-forged party are refused.
Only actual active reviewer connection can submit plans/activity/results; observers can query without acquiring authority.
Exact response replay is idempotent; foreign, stale or conflicting submissions do not replace accepted results or close a healthy owner merely for semantic errors.
Controller disconnect exposes interrupted state and preserves completed chunks; S1 does not automatically reassign/resume.
Identical valid native/controller results produce identical final status/counts and use the same policy/schema.

tests.name: Actual trusted owner connection/execution/sequence gates controller plan/activity/result, with idempotent exact replay and conflicting replay refusal.
Reviewing-controller disconnect retains completed chunks as interrupted with no automatic reassignment/recovery.
Equivalent native/controller feedback shares policy/schema and produces identical status/counts.
